content: Bab-Jehová gannar anga sogdebalid: “Be nae, we-ome-negsichigi-galagwensuli-nanaedse be monae, ar ade, dule-baid-e-ai-nuedga gudiid. Igi an Israel-dulemar-sabe, deyob be sabguo. Ar Israel-dulemar amba bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladba nanamar-inigwele, degi, uva-madu-olo bab-dummadyob-imaklemaladga-uklemalad gundimar-inigwele, amba an wile daked.”
Degisoggu, mani-sibugan-gwaambe-gakatar (15) an-ome-e-ai-nuedga-gudiid an bennuksad, degi, orosgisaar-dakleged-cebadaʼye-nugad galón-gwadulabake-gakabo (82) an ega uksabalid.
Geb an-omega an sogsad: “Be anbo iba-undar-nanadii guo. Galagwensuli bar be nanaosur. Bar bipisaale be machered-baidbo negsichigi nanaosur. ¡Anbela an ome-baidse achaosulid!”

Ar Israel-dulemar undar reysuli, degi, dule-negseedsuli gudii gumaloed. Degine, bar ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi ibmar-ukdii guosurmalad, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-mor-yoi guosurmalad, degine, ibmar-wagar-wilubganmar-sedii guosurmarbalid.

Geb sorbali, Israel-dulemar gannar na e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová amidmaloed, degi, e-rey-David amidmaloed. Ibagan-bergued-mosale, Bab-Jehová-dobekwaa gunonimaloed, degi, Bab-Dummad-e-nued-binsaed-egisnai gunonimaloed.
